detects: `stop` reports 'background capture stopped' even when no capture was running — the failure path now renders as the success path
why: SUBTLE, and the defect this command was written to prevent. Driven once, the output is word-for-word what a healthy stop prints, so any single run looks like a pass. The agent has to know from the feature map that `stop` has THREE mutually exclusive outcomes and drive the pair: stop on a clean sandbox (must say 'no tracked background capture was running') and stop after start (must say 'stopped'). An agent that checks exitCode learns nothing either — every branch exits 0.
